title: Pennsylvania's 15th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: Pennsylvania's 15th Congressional District covers a large swath of central and western Pennsylvania, including State College and rural communities. Incumbent Republican Rep. Glenn Thompson, first elected in 2008 and chair of the House Agriculture Committee, is seeking a 10th term. He faces Democratic nominee Ray Bilger, a retired U.S. Air Force veteran and former NSA intelligence analyst, in a district rated as safely Republican (Cook PVI R+19). The race presents a contrast between Thompson's long incumbency and agriculture policy leadership and Bilger's national security background and call for new representation.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race. The Cook Political Report rates the district as Solid Republican, and prediction markets indicate a high probability of Republican retention.

forecast.rationale: No public opinion polls exist for this race (based_on_poll_count=0), so the forecast rests entirely on structural and contextual factors. Pennsylvania's 15th District has a Cook PVI of R+19 and is rated Solid Republican by Cook Political Report, indicating an overwhelming Republican baseline. Incumbent Glenn Thompson has held the seat since 2008, chairs the House Agriculture Committee, and faces a Democratic challenger (Ray Bilger) in a district well aligned with Thompson's rural, agriculture-focused profile. While Bilger has a credible national security background, no countervailing dynamics are present in the data that would overcome the district's strong Republican lean. The safe_r rating reflects a ~95%+ Republican win probability, consistent with the structural evidence. Confidence is set to medium rather than high due to the complete absence of district-specific polling data.
